text:
alex-partner: FYI Saturn reported ~2.3% of yesterday's gateway batches with `entitlement_id` set to null. sample: {"gateway":"gw-900","timestamp":"2026-04-02T04:00:00Z","sku":"edge-max","units":480,"entitlement_id":null} 

toni-eng: Null causes validator to reject and we currently drop ledger rows -> partner sees missing usage. Can we avoid auto-crediting?

marta-billing: If rows drop, system issued small credits. We should quarantine instead and surface for mapping. Billing can't finalize until mapping confirmed.

rohan-integrations: Proposal: ingest null-entitlement into `partner.quarantine` with tag `null_ent`. Add a recon workflow where partner uploads mapping csv (gateway_id -> entitlement). Then run backfill to convert quarantined rows into ledger entries. ETA for quarantine path: 3h.

ops-ops: Any marketing impact? Is this limited?

alex-partner: limited to one pilot customer in APAC (~3 clusters). Partner will provide mapping by EOD PT. They request we hold announcement to APAC customers until reconciliation completes.

toni-eng: action items: (1) rohan: quarantine path + metric (ETA 3h), (2) toni: backfill job + manual confirm endpoint (ETA 18h), (3) marta: draft customer-facing note and reconciliation SLA (ETA 6h).

marketplace-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-1518 -> null-entitlement-quarantine (severity: low). Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-1518

marta-billing: Drafted note: "Some APAC customers may see delayed usage updates while we reconcile pilot device mappings; adjustments applied within 48h after mapping."

rohan-integrations: quarantine PR merged to staging. alert created if null_ent > 0.5% hourly.

alex-partner: partner uploaded mapping CSV at 2026-04-02T09:05Z. starting backfill now.

toni-eng: backfill complete; quarantined rows converted to provisional ledger; marked non-invoiceable until partner confirms.

marta-billing: reconciled and applied adjustments; credits reversed. customer notified.

ops-ops: Given limited scope and fast fix, OK to proceed with APAC announcement but include note about reconciliation window.

alex-partner: closing loop. thanks all. :raised_hands:
